R4D-grouse-drive-0001.name: By Kettle River
R4D-grouse-drive-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R4D-grouse-drive-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Keefer Lake Rd (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Keefer Lake Rd, 3.5 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
11 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
13 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 8 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Village of Nakusp, about 58 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.12042, -118.40674, pull off on Keefer Lake Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Keefer Lake Rd stretch, 3.5 km one way. About 71 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 8-13, Region 8. Season: grouse Sept 10 to Nov 30 and more rows (synopsis page 68, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
